scope: N1 expired-unadmitted replacement extension only; no Go consumer claim
assumptions: Authenticated canonical finalized absence at/before prior deadline
Readiness-certified/not-lost is honest-host assumption, not certificate validation predicate
witness_tightening: Require original attestation while unexpired for current counter+1/current version, then expiry, finalized absence, replacement and matching new admission. Adds four-bit issued-live observer and one candidate flag; no new action/guard. Issuance must also be in an unfinalized current block with no active reservation, so the original certificate was actually admissible at issuance; observer only.
